gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all priority schemes available in Jira so that I can understand how priorities are organized across different projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all priority schemes with their respective IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new priority scheme to better manage the priorities of my team's projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON object with the new priority scheme details and return the created scheme's ID and name.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get suggested priorities for a set of mappings so that I can efficiently assign priorities to issues.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of suggested priorities based on the provided mappings.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to see which priorities are available for a specific priority scheme to ensure that my team can use them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of available priorities for the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete an obsolete priority scheme to keep our Jira instance clean and organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified priority scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project lead, I need to update an existing priority scheme to reflect changes in our project management process.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated details of the priority scheme and return the updated scheme's information.

gold.user: As a team member, I want to view the priorities associated with a specific priority scheme to understand how tasks are prioritized.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of priorities linked to the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As a project coordinator, I want to know which projects are using a specific priority scheme to manage resources effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of projects that are associated with the specified priority scheme.
